description: Requesting and directly sharing a calendar: validation, duplicates, notification.

preconditions: An is an active Meeting Organizer (the viewer); Binh is an active user (the owner).
No share exists between Binh and An.
cases.inputs: actor: An; ownerId: Binh; level: "Level1"; start: 2026-11-18; end: 2026-12-18.
cases.return: Share created in status Pending, InitiatedBy Viewer, owner Binh, viewer An; Success Requested (MSG435); share view returned.
cases.log: Share saved; notification CalendarShareRequested queued for Binh ("Yêu cầu xem lịch"); audit action calendar_share.requested by An with owner, viewer, level and dates.
